resources.string: ENI file
Gathers the ENI documents in a folder into one file and signs its index.
Choose the ENI documents folder
No folder chosen. It must contain ENI documents in XML.
Remove the folder
DIR3 bodies (required)
One or more codes separated by commas, for example L01180877.
Procedure classification (required)
SIA code, or a DIR3 code followed by _PRO_ and an identifier.
File status
File identifier (optional)
If you leave it empty, one is generated.
Interested parties (optional)
Separate each person with a semicolon.
Opening date: today
Opening date: %1$s
Choose the opening date
Use today’s date
File opening date
The index is signed with the session certificate, which must have an RSA key. With a DNIe, the PIN is asked once.
Create and sign the file
The folder has no XML documents. Choose the folder that contains the ENI documents.
The folder has more than 64 documents. Remove documents or split the file.
The documents take up more than 32 MiB. Remove documents from the folder.
The file was not created. These files are not valid ENI documents:
File created and signed. Choose where to save it.
File: %1$s
Batch operation
Sign
Co-sign (add my signature to files already signed)
Add the visible seal to the PDFs
The seal saved in “Visible signature” is used. If a PDF has fewer pages than the one chosen, the seal goes on the last page. The CSV legend is not added in a batch.
The visible seal for %1$s could not be prepared. Remove that PDF from the batch or sign without the seal.
With a DNIe, the PIN is asked only once for the whole batch. Keep the DNIe against the phone until it finishes.

Choose up to 16 files (32 MiB in total). They are signed with the session certificate (PKCS#12 or DNIe) and with the format, profile and TSA chosen above. When finished, choose a folder to save the signatures.
Batch co-signed
To protect and sign you need a certificate in the session (PKCS#12 or DNIe) and a recipient format.

6. In “Signature format” you can also choose XMLdSig, ODF, OOXML, FacturaE, ASiC-XAdES or “Veri*Factu record”. These formats need an RSA certificate and produce B-level signatures. For PDFs, the seal editor lets you add the CSV legend and place the seal on several pages.

7. In “Veri*Factu and ENI” you can check invoicing records without sending anything to the AEAT, create an ENI document from the chosen signature and check the structure of an ENI.

8. In “ENI file”, choose the folder with the ENI documents, fill in the bodies, classification and status, and tap “Create and sign the file”. The documents are sorted by name and the index is signed with your certificate.

Fourth wave: ENI file with a signed index; batch with a visible seal on PDFs and with co-signing; DNIe in batches (PIN asked once) and in protect and sign. XMLdSig, ODF, OOXML, FacturaE and ASiC-XAdES still sign only at level B, like the desktop engine.
